LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANT SHAMROCK MOVING & STORAGE, INCORPORATED'S PETITION TO COMPEL ARBITRATION IS GRANTED. THE AGREEMENT IS PROCEDURALLY UNCONSIONABLE BUT IT IS MUTUAL, AND THE ONLY OTHER DEFECT ARGUED AS SUBSTANTIVELY UNCONSCIONABLE IS COST SPLITTING WHICH THE COURT SEVERS AND WILL NOT ENFORCE. THE ACTION IS STAYED PENDING ARBITRATION. THE COURT ORDERED MR. WENBOURNE TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR# 8189
